easy.title: Investigate the pressure on Venus' surface.
easy.description: Corpedia wishes to explore the habitation potential of the planet Venus; deploy a satellite capable of monitoring atmospheric pressure to the planet.

easy.title: Measure the temperature data of Uranus.
easy.description: Corpedia wants to explore Uranus as a potential site for the construction of a cryogenic weapons facility; deploy a satellite capable of measuring its local temperature.

easy.title: Retrieve Earth humidity data.
easy.description: Corpedia records indicate that Earth was once a lush world with a great resource; water. Deploy a satellite capable of analyzing humidity data on the planet.

easy.title: Deploy a satellite capable of long range travel to the asteroid belt.
easy.description: Potential mineral deposits embedded in asteroids within the asteroid belt require immediate satellite analysis; deploy a satellite with enough power to travel to the asteroid belt.

easy.title: Collect topographic map data of the Moon.
easy.description: Corpedia is interested in potential ruin sites on the Moon; deploy a satellite with the instruments necessary to collect topographic data.

easy.title: Collect solar radiation data.
easy.description: Corpedia is interested in harnessing solar radiation as a form of energy; deploy a satellite that can measure radiation data.

easy.title: Investigate an unknown signal above Mars.
easy.description: Corpedia would like to remind all employees that all rumors of Martians are myth, rumor, and hearsay. Deploy a satellite that can recieve and transmit signals long range.

medium.title: Record Earth's temperature and radiation data.
medium.description: Corpedia is legally mandated to verify the historical accuracy of claims of nuclear radiation on the Earth's surface. Deploy a satellite capable of recording both temperature and radiation info.

medium.title: Conduct long term research of Neptune's gravity.
medium.description: Corpedia, in a charitable donation of information to the Society of Gravitational Investigation, requires data on Neptune's gravitational pull over a long period of time. Deploy a satellite with enough power for long term research that can also measure gravity.

medium.title: Obtain pictures and topographical maps of Mars.
medium.description: Corpedia would like to remind all employees that any and all depictions of Martian civilization are completely fabricated. Deploy a satellite capable of taking pictures and producing topographical maps.

medium.title: Analyze the atmospheric composition and pressure of Jupiter.
medium.description: To outline parameters for future operations on Jupiter, deploy a satellite both able to analyze atmospheric composition and pressure.

medium.title: Obtain information on the magnetic properties of Saturn's rings.
medium.description: Before mining operations can begin on Saturn's rings, Corpedia requires data on their potential magnetism; additionally, ensure the satellite is equipped for long distance signal transception.

hard.title: Compile a long term report on Earth's topographic data and atmospheric composition.
hard.description: Earth is a barren rock. Corpedia requires a satellite with the power supply for long term analysis, and a system to obtain topograhic data and atmospheric composition.

hard.title: Compile an indepth report on Mars' local radiation, gravity, and magnetic data.
hard.description: Corpedia would like to remind all its employees that there are no Martian weapon caches hidden beneath the surface of the planet. Deploy a satellite that can analyze Mars' radiation, gravity, and magnetic data.

hard.title: Deploy a satellite capable of a long distance voyage to the edge of the solar system.
hard.description: In partnership with Galactic Atlas, Corpedia requires a satellite capable of long distance travel, with devices to monitor local temperatures and the rotation of the satellite.

hard.title: Analyze Mercury's potential shareholder value.
hard.description: Corpedia, to produce an accurate financial gains estimate on Mercury, requires temperature data, a topographic map, and images of the planet.

hard.title: Perform scans of Uranus' surface.
hard.description: To facilitate the approved construction of a cryogenics weapons facility on Uranus' surface, Corpedia requires a satellite capable of surviving in an extremely cold environment to collect topographical and atmospheric pressure data.

hard.title: Analyze the atmospheric properties of Jupiter.
hard.description: Corpedia would like to remind all employees that the infamous storm of Jupiter is a natural phenomenon and not at all a sign of the end times. Deploy a satellite able to monitor atmospheric pressure, composition, and take pictures.
